Name: ai-planet-altitude-alignment
Commands:
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight speed to 8
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight precision to false
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight avoidance to false
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight altitude to 200
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight gravity alignment to true
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight behavior to true
set "EC Drone Recorder" ai recorder repeat path to false
set "EC Drone Recorder" ai recorder play to true
wait 60
set "EC Drone Flight" ai flight altitude to 100
set "EC Drone Recorder" ai recorder play to true
wait 45
print "EC_PASS"
